name: Valles de Sadacia

known.via: English Wikipedia "Valles de Sadacia" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Vino de la Tierra indication in La Rioja that includes only white wines, in three styles: dry, semi-dry and sweet. It sits one step below Denominación de Origen on the Spanish quality ladder.
